Regles.title: The rules
Regles.intro: Predict which biathletes will perform, play their odds, and try to grab the Yellow Bib as the season's best predictor.
Regles.baremeHint: Odds × multiplier based on finishing rank. Nothing beyond 10th place.
Regles.s_principe_body: For each individual race, pick 3 biathletes. The riskier your pick (higher odds), the more it can pay off — but it must finish in the Top 10. Combination bonuses: Podium (+100), Top 5 (+50), Top 10 (+20), and a Perfect Pick if you find the 3 highest-scoring biathletes (+200).
Regles.s_grillage_body: A biathlete you pick becomes unavailable for the next race of the same stage. They become available again at the next stage (unless you use the Meltdown card).
Regles.s_cotes_body: Each biathlete has odds per format (sprint/pursuit/individual/mass start), re-evaluated at key points in the season. Pursuit odds are recalculated automatically after the sprint: +5 per 20s of gap (first bracket neutral), capped at 40.
Regles.s_relais_body: You predict a nation instead of 3 biathletes. Only the top 5 nations score, on a reduced scale compared to individual races.
Regles.s_globes_body: Before the season starts: overall winner, best young athlete, and best nation, for both men and women. The overall globe rewards precision on the final Top 5 the most.
Regles.s_bonusx2_body: 3 uses per season, on a World Cup individual race or relay (not on World Champs/Olympics or special races). Doubles every point from that prediction.
Regles.s_mondiaux_body: Every race at these events counts double automatically, not stackable with the personal ×2 bonus.
Regles.s_special_body: Penalty loop: -20 pts per penalty loop by your biathletes. Fog: outside the Top 10, a malus equal to the finishing position. Busted: a malus if one or more of your 3 picks finish outside the Top 10 (up to -300), and -200 if you don't predict at all.
Regles.s_teamnation_body: Pick a favorite team (nation + sex) for the season. On the stage held in its country, points from that team's athlete you predicted are doubled (Team Nation bonus). Independently of your prediction, the more of that team's athletes finish Top 10 in a race, the more points you get (Draft bonus).
Regles.s_streak_body: 10 consecutive races scoring points earn you a bonus card: Wildcard (4 picks, best 3 count), Boost (×3 on one athlete), Meltdown (exceptional un-burning), Black Cat (fix one globe pick before the end of stage 3).
Regles.s_pepite_body: A bet placed at the start of the season on an outsider per sex (odds ≥ 30). A hidden pick: on their first Top 10 of the season, their race score is added as a bonus, then they become a regular athlete again.
Regles.s_fuseegachette_body: Rocket: +50 pts if one of your picks had the race's best ski time (once). Trigger: +20 pts per pick with a clean shooting round (stackable).
Regles.s_classement_body: Adds up every point scored over the season. The leader wears the Yellow Bib. Secondary standings (Red Bib) and private leagues between friends also exist.

Support.title: Support
Support.intro: A question, a bug, an idea? We'll get back to you.

sections.title: Contact us
sections.body: Write to us at {email}. Tell us your username and, if relevant, the race concerned: we usually reply within 48 hours.

sections.title: Game rules
sections.body: Scoring, bonus cards, burned athletes, season globes: everything is explained in the rules.

sections.title: Your account
sections.body: You can change your favorite nation from the Account page. To delete your account and data, write to us from your account's email address.

Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.intro: Draft document, to be validated before the game opens to the public.

sections.title: Data collected
sections.body: Your email address and (encrypted) password to sign in, your username, favorite nation, predictions, bonus cards and leagues.

sections.title: Use
sections.body: This data is only used to run the game: points, standings and leagues. It is never sold or shared with third parties.

sections.title: Hosting
sections.body: Data is stored with our database provider (Supabase).

sections.title: Retention
sections.body: Your data is kept as long as your account exists, and deleted on request.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: Under the GDPR, you can access, correct or delete your data by writing to support.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.body: The site only uses the cookies needed to keep you signed in. No advertising cookies for now.

Terms.title: Terms of use
Terms.intro: Draft document, to be validated before the game opens to the public.

sections.title: Purpose
sections.body: Biathlonpronos is a free biathlon prediction game. It is not affiliated with the IBU or any federation.

sections.title: Free to play
sections.body: The game is entirely free. No real money wagered, no financial winnings: this is not a gambling game.

sections.title: Account
sections.body: One account per person. Your username must not be offensive or impersonate someone else.

sections.title: Game rules
sections.body: Points are calculated according to the rules published on the site. In case of dispute over a result, the game organiser's decision is final.

sections.title: Conduct
sections.body: Any abusive behaviour (multiple accounts, cheating, insults in leagues) may lead to account deletion.

sections.title: Changes
sections.body: These terms may change. The version online is the one that applies.
